messages:
Maya (Docs): starting a short thread to finalize the release note for the embed routing refinement. I want a tiny "what changed" bullet, a 1-line migration tip, and the SDK snippets aligned. PR will be tiny.
Carlos (Product): tl;dr: default now prefers latency, theres an opt-in deterministic mode, and a small cache-warmup ordering caveat. Keep customer copy concise.
Liu (SDK): I'll add examples for JS + Python. Quick question: is the field `route_hint` with values `latency` or `deterministic`?
Priya (Eng): yes, `route_hint` is the one. Also note we renamed model alias from `embed-fast` to `embed-express-v1`. 301 redirects will exist but call out the new name.
Maya (Docs): draft migration line: "If your app needs deterministic token ordering, set `route_hint: \"deterministic\"` (may slightly increase latency)." Thoughts?
Carlos (Product): good. Add a one-line known issue: "Initial requests after cache cold-start may exhibit minor token-order differences; KB link placeholder: https://kb.redwood.ai/embed-routing-ordering"
Liu (SDK): will mirror the migration tip in SDK README and add a commented guard in examples: `# set route_hint: "deterministic" for exact ordering`
Priya (Eng): small dev note: prefix caching can reorder a token on first use; it stabilizes after warmup. Recommend including that language.
Maya (Docs): adding: "Note: prefix cache warmup can briefly affect token order for early requests."
preview-bot: Preview for docs PR #5402 is live: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-5402 :white_check_mark:
Carlos (Product): mobile rendering check: avoid side-by-side tables. single code block per snippet please.
Liu (SDK): noted. examples will be standalone blocks. I'll include a streaming variant too so users see the flag.
Maya (Docs): sample curl I will include (compact): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-express-v1","route_hint":"latency","input":"hello","stream":false}'
```
Priya (Eng): I'll publish the KB stub by Wednesday and confirm redirect behavior.
Carlos (Product): timeline: want this published Friday AM. Is that doable?
Priya (Eng): yes, runtime redirect + KB stub by Thu.
Liu (SDK): SDK patches by Thu EOD.
Maya (Docs): checklist before merge: 1) SDK snippets updated (liu) 2) KB link stub (priya) 3) preview sanity + mobile check (carlos) 4) add known-issues anchor (maya). Tagging reviewers now.
Carlos (Product): thanks all. once merged i'll post a short note in #announcements and ping support. :tada:
